title: Eleven Music v2.5
summary: Generate music with Eleven Music v2.5
description: Eleven Music v2.5 by ElevenLabs — full songs with vocals, or instrumentals, 10 seconds to 5 minutes long, from a style prompt and optional lyrics it sings as written. Priced at 200 credits per minute of the requested duration, billed per second with a 10-second minimum (10 s = 34 credits, 30 s = 100, 300 s = 1000); POST /v1/cost quotes the exact price. MP3 output (44.1 kHz, 128 kbps). Prompts that name artists, songs, albums or record labels are refused, uncharged, with a suggested rewrite.

duration.description: Length of the song in seconds (10-300). Billed per second of the requested length at the per-minute rate, 10-second minimum.

instrumental.description: Generate an instrumental track (no vocals). Cannot be combined with lyrics.

lyrics.description: Optional lyrics to sing as written (up to 3000 characters; prompt and lyrics together at most 4090). Cannot be combined with instrumental.

prompt.description: Style and description of the song (up to 2000 characters): genre, mood, instruments, tempo, vocals — e.g. "warm indie folk, acoustic guitar, soft female vocal, 90 BPM". Prompts that name artists, songs, albums or record labels are refused.
